title: Nvidia to invest up to $100B in OpenAI (letter of intent)

sources.quote: To support the partnership, NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI progressively as each gigawatt is deployed.
In the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, we entered into a letter of intent with an opportunity to invest in OpenAI.

explain: Nvidia signed a non-binding letter of intent to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI, step by step as OpenAI deployed 10 gigawatts of Nvidia systems. It was never turned into a final contract; in February 2026 it was replaced by a $30 billion equity investment.
